Regencell Foundation is honored to have partnered with the Society for Community Organization (SoCO) to extend practical aid, essential care packages, and warm smiles to 200 underserved families residing in caged homes and subdivided units across Hong Kong.


Creating a tangible, positive impact in the communities where we live and operate remains at the core of our corporate values.


About SoCO


The Society for Community Organization (SoCO) was founded in 1971 by clergymen and community members dedicated to Hong Kong’s social reform. SoCO campaigns for a fair and just social system through advocacy, civil rights education, and direct community engagement, promoting equality and respect for all members of society.
